set.body:
Purpose and scope
Generate bounded multi-participant/session/release corpora and query cases for the existing query algebra. Compute expected results with a deliberately simple standalone evaluator over generated source facts, not by invoking ScientificQuery.matches or copying SQL. Preserve lexical IDs, absent sessions and numeric-versus-lexical participant semantics.

Acceptance proof
Fixed seeds reproduce exact expected memberships. Cases include conjunctions satisfied only across different participants/sessions, same labels in different releases, zero padding, missing fields, decimal boundaries and nested predicates. Failures report seed, source fixture and query; generated accepted inventories respect current limits.

Start here
modules/kernel/src/main/scala/sanctity/kernel/Query.scala; modules/app/src/test/scala/sanctity/app; modules/integration/src/test/scala/sanctity/postgres

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: Q1: Build a seeded independent oracle for scientific query correlation
